draft.assessment: Structured treatment-plan note drafted. Based on active PTSD (PCL-5 49; CAPS-5 severe), prior CPT with partial response, and complex medical context (CKD and kidney transplant planning), the plan emphasizes a structured reassessment, safety/medical coordination, and an individualized trauma-focused psychotherapy plan with measurement-based monitoring. Pharmacotherapy is deferred pending comprehensive medical reconciliation; nonpharmacologic options are described with explicit evidence limitations.

recommended_plan.text: Undertake structured reassessment and select initial trauma-focused modality (reformulated CPT or WET) aligned with patient preferences and feasibility.
recommended_plan.rationale: Partial response to prior CPT warrants adaptation and explicit readiness assessment prior to processing the index trauma.
cautions: Ensure medical clearance given CKD/transplant context; avoid excessive homework load; verify trauma chronology.

recommended_plan.text: Repeat a formal suicide-risk assessment and document protective factors, crisis resources, and a formal safety plan; confirm CKD status and transplant considerations with nephrology team.
recommended_plan.rationale: Safety planning and medical coordination are essential given the medical complexity and potential risk changes.
cautions: Not to rely on prior 'suicide risk flagged' alone; ensure up-to-date assessment.

recommended_plan.text: Discuss renewed trauma-focused therapy, either reformulated CPT or an alternative evidence-based modality, tailored to patient cognitive style, treatment history, and ability to engage in between-session work.
recommended_plan.rationale: Prior partial response indicates adaptation rather than abandonment; therapy choice should be individualized and documented.
cautions: Assess feasibility of homework; ensure alignment with medical status and kidney transplant considerations.

recommended_plan.text: Consider brief exposure therapy (WET) as a potential brief option when treatment burden or rapid relief is prioritized; discuss risks, tolerability, and patient preferences; do not initiate without institutional policy guidance.
recommended_plan.rationale: WET has reported brief format and tolerability; applicability should be individualized and not assumed in this patient.
cautions: Not standard care; ensure policy approvals and patient suitability.

recommended_plan.text: Implement regular outcome monitoring with PCL-5 (and CAPS-5 when possible) at defined intervals, document symptom clusters, functioning, attendance, adverse effects, and patient goals; adjust plan based on trajectory.
recommended_plan.rationale: Longitudinal change tracking supports objective assessment of progress and guides treatment adjustments.
cautions: If multiple assessments burden the patient, adjust frequency.

recommended_plan.text: Obtain detailed CPT history: number and spacing of sessions, fidelity, homework completion, targets addressed, residual symptoms, adverse effects, and reasons for discontinuation.
recommended_plan.rationale: Detailed prior CPT data informs adaptation and future therapy planning.
cautions: Ensure access to prior CPT records; consider privacy and data quality.

monitoring: PTSD symptom tracking with PCL-5 and CAPS-5 at defined intervals
Suicide risk assessment at each visit; update crisis plan
Medical status monitoring: CKD labs, anemia, respiratory status
Medication safety monitoring if pharmacotherapy is pursued
reassessment_triggers: Worsening PTSD symptoms or functional decline
New or worsening suicidality or self-harm risk
Medical status changes (CKD progression, transplant considerations)
Insufficient response after defined trauma-focused course
Emergence of comorbid mood/anxiety symptoms or substance use
Patient preference shift toward pharmacologic or alternative modalities
missing: Current structured suicide-risk assessment and crisis plan
Reconciled CKD stage and current nephrology/transplant status
Substance use status and treatment history
Current renal labs (eGFR, creatinine) and anemia status
Prior CPT details (sessions, fidelity, homework, goals)
